sources.title: mlir-air/programming_examples/llms/qwen25_3b at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: End-to-end Qwen2.5-3B (3B parameter, BF16) inference running on AMD NPU2 (AIE2P) hardware via MLIR-AIR. Supports both prefill (seq_len=2048) and autoregressive decode with a KV cache.

sources.title: mlir-air/programming_examples/llms/llama32_3b_q4nx at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: LLAMA-3.2-3B Q4NX Inference on AMD NPU2 (MLIR-AIR) A full prefill + decode MLIR-AIR inference for Llama-3.2-3B using Q4NX weights (per-block 4-bit affine quantization, w = q*scale + min) on NPU2 (AIE2P). Same on-device pipeline as the sibling bf16 llama32_3b example — only the weight source differs: FastFlowLM's single model.q4nx bundle, dequantized Q4NX→bf16 on the host at load.
